propositions: Bridge harness git() and bare_git() helpers inherit os.environ wholesale, exposing command-scope git-config injection (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/GIT_CONFIG_KEY_*/GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_*) that blocks bare repository access on dev hosts.

Matrix test test_five_environment_matrix_has_identical_results_without_gh fails with 'fatal: cannot use bare repository (safe.bareRepository is explicit)' on dev hosts where agent harnesses export safe.bareRepository=explicit, while passing in CI where no such ambient vars exist.
Harness fix scrubs GIT_CONFIG_* injection vars and pins GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null + GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 in git helpers and runner_env() to hold out ambient host git config.
Strengthened matrix test monkeypatches hostile GIT_CONFIG_* injection unconditionally to exercise the held-out contract deterministically on all hosts, enabling regression coverage in CI.

Sibling tests test_run_reconcile_bridge_heldout.py and test_bridge_runner_install_paths_heldout.py suffer the same class of failure (21 total) on hostile hosts and are fixed by the shared-harness scrubbing.
